classification.difficultyReason: Identify quadrilaterals from property marks and select the appropriate area formula, including rotated figures and externally indicated diagonals.

content.prompt: Identify the special quadrilateral then calculate the area of each special quadrilateral.

spec.description: Right-leaning parallelogram with a 10 m horizontal base and a 5 m perpendicular height. Horizontal sides have double parallel arrows; sloping sides have single parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: Area uses the base and perpendicular height: A=10×5.
spec.answerVisibility: Dimensions, property marks and dashed height are permanent givens; the final area is excluded.

answer.worked:
Parallelogram: both pairs of opposite sides are parallel.
$$\begin{align*}A&=bh\\A&=10\times5\\A&=50\,\mathrm{m}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Tall tilted rhombus with all four sides marked equal. One dashed diagonal is labelled 3.1 m; an external parallel dimension leader indicates the other diagonal, 6.2 m.
spec.mathematics: All sides are equal. The area is half the product of the two diagonals, 3.1 m and 6.2 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Equality marks and both diagonal measurements are permanent givens; identification and final area are excluded.

answer.worked:
Rhombus: all four sides are equal. The diagonal lengths are $3.1\,\mathrm{m}$ and $6.2\,\mathrm{m}$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{xy}{2}\\A&=\frac{3.1\times6.2}{2}\\A&=9.61\,\mathrm{m}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Oblique trapezium with parallel sides rising right, labelled 20 mm and 50 mm. The dashed perpendicular height is 16 mm and has a right-angle marker at the long side.
spec.mathematics: The 20 mm and 50 mm sides are parallel; the 16 mm measurement is their perpendicular separation.
spec.answerVisibility: Parallel arrows, dimensions and perpendicular-height marks are permanent givens; identification and final area are excluded.

answer.worked:
Trapezium: one pair of opposite sides is parallel.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{h(a+b)}{2}\\A&=\frac{16(20+50)}{2}\\A&=560\,\mathrm{mm}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right-leaning rhombus with horizontal top and bottom and all sides marked equal. The upper-left to lower-right dashed diagonal is 5 cm; an external leader indicates the other diagonal, 3 cm.
spec.mathematics: The area is half the product of the diagonals, 5 cm and 3 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Equality ticks and diagonal measurements are permanent givens; identification and final area are excluded.

answer.worked:
Rhombus: all four sides are equal.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{xy}{2}\\A&=\frac{5\times3}{2}\\A&=7.5\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Oblique trapezium with a long left/upper parallel side labelled 9 m and a short lower-right parallel side labelled 4 m. A 5 m dashed height runs from the lower vertex to the long parallel side, with a right-angle marker at its foot.
spec.mathematics: The parallel-side lengths are 9 m and 4 m; their perpendicular separation is 5 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Both parallel-side dimensions and the perpendicular height are permanent givens; identification and final area are excluded.

answer.worked:
Trapezium: the $9\,\mathrm{m}$ and $4\,\mathrm{m}$ sides are parallel.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{h(a+b)}{2}\\A&=\frac{5(9+4)}{2}\\A&=32.5\,\mathrm{m}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Parallelogram with horizontal top and bottom, bottom base labelled 3 cm, and interior vertical dashed height labelled 1.5 cm. Matching double arrows mark horizontal sides and single arrows mark sloping sides.
spec.mathematics: The 1.5 cm measurement is perpendicular to the 3 cm base.
spec.answerVisibility: Dimensions, parallel arrows and right-angle marker are permanent givens; identification and final area are excluded.

answer.worked:
Parallelogram: both pairs of opposite sides are parallel.
$$\begin{align*}A&=bh\\A&=3\times1.5\\A&=4.5\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Trapezium with horizontal parallel sides labelled 7 cm and 17 cm. A vertical dashed height near the left is labelled 8 cm and has a right-angle marker at the bottom.
spec.mathematics: Parallel sides are 7 cm and 17 cm; perpendicular height is 8 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Dimensions, parallel arrows and perpendicular-height marker are permanent givens; identification and final area are excluded.

answer.worked:
Trapezium: one pair of opposite sides is parallel.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{h(a+b)}{2}\\A&=\frac{8(7+17)}{2}\\A&=96\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right-pointing kite. The shorter left sides have single equality ticks; the longer right sides have double ticks. A vertical dashed diagonal is labelled 20 mm; an external horizontal leader below indicates the other diagonal, 30 mm.
spec.mathematics: Two pairs of adjacent sides are equal. The diagonals are 20 mm and 30 mm.
spec.answerVisibility: Equality marks and diagonal measurements are permanent givens; identification and final area are excluded.

answer.worked:
Kite: two pairs of adjacent sides are equal.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{xy}{2}\\A&=\frac{20\times30}{2}\\A&=300\,\mathrm{mm}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Tilted kite with equal shorter left and bottom sides and equal longer top and right sides. A dashed upper-left to lower-right diagonal is labelled 1 mm; an external diagonal leader indicates the other diagonal, 1.8 mm.
spec.mathematics: The area uses diagonals of 1 mm and 1.8 mm.
spec.answerVisibility: Equality ticks and diagonal dimensions are permanent givens; identification and final area are excluded.

answer.worked:
Kite: two pairs of adjacent sides are equal.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{xy}{2}\\A&=\frac{1\times1.8}{2}\\A&=0.9\,\mathrm{mm}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Rotated rectangle with four right-angle markers. Short sides have single equality ticks and a 5 cm label; long sides have double ticks and an 11 cm label.
spec.mathematics: The perpendicular side lengths are 11 cm and 5 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Right-angle markers, equality ticks and side lengths are permanent givens; identification and final area are excluded.

answer.worked:
Rectangle: all four angles are right angles.
$$\begin{align*}A&=lw\\A&=11\times5\\A&=55\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right trapezium with 2 cm top, 4 cm bottom and 2 cm vertical left side. Top and bottom have matching parallel arrows; both left vertices have right-angle markers.
spec.mathematics: The vertical left side gives the perpendicular height of 2 cm between the 2 cm and 4 cm parallel sides.
spec.answerVisibility: All three dimensions, parallel arrows and right-angle markers are permanent givens; identification and final area are excluded.

answer.worked:
Trapezium: the $2\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $4\,\mathrm{cm}$ horizontal sides are parallel. The vertical side is the perpendicular height.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{h(a+b)}{2}\\A&=\frac{2(2+4)}{2}\\A&=6\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Trapezium with vertical parallel sides labelled 3 cm and 10 cm, marked by upward arrows. The horizontal top is labelled 13 cm and meets both vertical sides at right angles. The bottom slopes down to the right.
spec.mathematics: The parallel sides are 3 cm and 10 cm. Their perpendicular separation is the 13 cm horizontal top.
spec.answerVisibility: All three dimensions, parallel arrows and right-angle markers are permanent givens; identification and final area are excluded.

answer.worked:
Trapezium: the $3\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $10\,\mathrm{cm}$ vertical sides are parallel. Their perpendicular separation is $13\,\mathrm{cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{h(a+b)}{2}\\A&=\frac{13(3+10)}{2}\\A&=84.5\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}\end{align*}$$
